$comment: Obligations that come due on a date rather than on a code change.
scripts/check_dated_obligations.py fails once `due` minus `lead_days` has passed,
so the deadline arrives as a failing gate rather than as a note somebody has to reread.
Publishable fields only. A support case number, an account ID or a file system ID
belongs in the file named by `private_ref`, which is gitignored -- not here.
This repository is public and its git history is permanent.

obligations.what: Delete the SnapLock audit log volume, then open a fresh AWS Support case for the billing conversation, attaching the earlier case ID from the private note.
obligations.why: The volume carries a 6-month minimum retention that blocks deletion of the volume, its SVM and the file system. AWS confirmed there is no route to early deletion, and that a case cannot be held open for half a year, so the follow-up has to be re-opened at expiry rather than continued.
